description: T-2007 attempt 2: ODDFYIELD stopping-gap sweeps. Sheet S: A-C ODDFYIELD of three bonds (semiannual 5% coupon; the same at a 0% coupon; annual 6% coupon, redemption 120) over prices 50 to 150 in steps of 1 (rows 1-101). E-F invert G-H, ODDFPRICE of the first and third bond at yields 0 to 0.3 in steps of 0.005 (rows 1-61), so the root is known to the price's rounding.
